propositions: rebar-brainstorm currently instructs running plan-review on each ticket immediately after creation, before dependency links exist and regardless of blocked state
plan-review gate fast-fails with exit 2 and INDETERMINATE on tickets that are blocked by unclosed dependencies, making immediate review wasteful
plan-review reviews must run in dependency order (prerequisites before dependents), never in parallel
rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md must be rewritten to establish dependency graph first, then run plan-review only on unblocked tickets identified by rebar ready, in dependency order
rebar-implement/SKILL.md already correctly treats the dependency graph as a precondition and reviews only the unblocked, dependency-ordered set via rebar ready/next-batch, requiring no change
